parallel.requirements: Recognized that the task was to clean-room reimplement the ditaa executable from observed behavior and bundled docs only.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Parent planned probing, language/architecture, implementation, feature rendering, HTML/SVG, and verification, then delegated eight probe/spec children while retaining later implementation work.
parallel.implementation: No replacement source or compile path was created. Parallel work consisted of a PNG helper, experiments, and probe notes.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: There was no integration of child findings into a program and no buildable deliverable; artifact packaging captured the original workspace-like files only.
parallel.verification: Verification remained planned but unexecuted for any replacement executable; official evaluation reached compile_failed with all tests not run.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Seven child scopes were aborted, parent was canceled at the swarm result, and implementation/build/acceptance never started.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same clean-room reimplementation obligation and explored the provided executable and documentation without delegation.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Single main actor planned CLI, geometry, shapes, implementation, and pixel comparison work in sequence.
serial.implementation: The serial run produced only probe helpers and experimental measurements; it did not create source for a replacement executable.
serial.integration_and_delivery: No components were integrated and no buildable replacement was delivered; artifact packaging similarly lacked a solution implementation.
serial.verification: The actor compared observed outputs while probing but never reached end-to-end validation of a reimplementation; official evaluation compile failed.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial run timed out during text/font investigation with implementation and comparison work still pending.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the clean-room requirement and observed ditaa behavior without web/source lookup.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same prompt and constraints and likewise used runtime observation and bundled docs.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition difference; both understood the task but did not deliver an implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel kept implementation tasks on the parent todo list but delegated eight behavior-probing areas to children.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept a single todo list covering probing, implementation, and comparison in one actor.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel decomposed only investigation across child agents, while serial performed the same broad investigation inline.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children received a shared probing preamble and separate note deliverables, not implementation interfaces.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child briefs or handoffs; its observations remained in the main context.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel created a distributed spec-handoff surface, whereas serial had no cross-agent interface to reconcile.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel never moved from helper/probe artifacts into source for a replacement executable.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also never moved from probing into implementation source before cancellation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both lacked implementation; parallel's path was blocked behind the swarm, serial's path was blocked by continued solo probing.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The swarm result arrived at cancellation with one completed child and seven aborted children.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results; the main actor itself was canceled mid-investigation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had lost/unfinished child-result lifecycle state; serial did not have child lifecycle failure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel created shared scratch helpers and notes, including CLI and HTML/SVG notes, but did not integrate them into a final codebase.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote one PNG decoder helper and kept probe outputs local without any integration stage.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had more distributed scratch state but neither mode integrated artifacts into a submitted implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel did not run evaluator-aligned verification of a replacement and officially compile failed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial likewise did not run end-to-end verification of a replacement and officially compile failed.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No acceptance difference; both had probing checks but no buildable artifact for official tests.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used native swarm mode, ran for the full budget, and was canceled around the swarm return.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also ran to the full budget, but without subagent activity.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both timed out, but parallel spent the deadline across probe children while serial spent it in one continuing investigation.

outcome_analysis.explanation: There is no discordant official outcome: parallel and serial both failed 0/681 with compile_failed. The concrete difference is process shape, not score: parallel deferred all productive implementation behind a child-agent investigation swarm, while serial kept a single actor probing. Both ended without a buildable replacement executable.
parallel_contributors: Probe-only swarm consumed the remaining run window and returned with seven aborted children.
Parent never integrated probe findings into implementation, build, or acceptance work.
serial_contributors: Single actor continued detailed behavioral probing until cancellation.
Implementation and comparison todos remained pending when the serial run ended.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Neither run produced a replacement codebase; the official failure was a missing/compile-failed deliverable rather than a wrong algorithm in submitted code.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained pattern is a parallel adverse process pattern, not a discordant-outcome explanation

candidates.reason: Rejected because the parallel parent explicitly kept implementation work on its todo list; the problem was that implementation was delayed behind investigation, not unassigned.
Rejected because no independent component implementations were produced, so there was no integration ownership gap to realize.
Rejected because no buildable implementation or component set reached final packaging; assembly never became the earliest unowned object.
Rejected because the parent owned the end-to-end plan in its todo list; the run failed before executing later stages.
Rejected because the gate was not one mandatory serial harness or oracle step; the parallel work was a broad investigation phase split across many children.

The parallel parent placed all executed child work into a first-phase behavioral investigation swarm while implementation and verification remained pending. The swarm returned only at cancellation with one completed child and seven aborted children, so implementation never started.
candidates.realized_consequence: Implementation, build, and acceptance work were left behind the probe phase; cancellation returned one completed child and seven aborted children with no buildable replacement executable.
candidates.near_match_reason: The cancellations are visible, but they are the terminal symptom of the same probe-only first phase; the corrective boundary is to parallelize or start implementation rather than wait for all probes.

Rejected because no single child had a uniquely dominant overbroad implementation task; several probing scopes were unfinished in the same retained phase.

Rejected because the children were not assigned separately owned implementation components that needed to interoperate; they were producing behavior notes.

Rejected because no receiver acted on superseded child information; the parent did not reach an integration decision after the swarm.
Rejected because no incompatible child reports reached the parent and remained unadjudicated at a decision point.
Rejected because the parent never presented or accepted a whole-task completion; the run was canceled before finalization.
Rejected because there was no replacement or retry child without inherited state.

retained_patterns.reason: The executed parallel work was an investigation-only swarm, while implementation and verification stayed queued on the parent plan. The parent did not start coding before the swarm result arrived at cancellation with seven aborted children.
retained_patterns.realized_consequence: Productive implementation and verification never began before cancellation, leaving no buildable reimplementation even though the swarm consumed the parallel run's remaining time.
retained_patterns.near_match_reason: Child cancellation is evidenced, but retaining it separately would duplicate the same timeout chain; the more specific corrective boundary is the probe-only phase design.

suppressed_same_chain_candidates: Early Child Termination, Critical-Path Starvation, Fan-out Budget Exhaustion, Oversized Child Task, Blind Timeout Wait, and No Failure Takeover were reviewed as the same timeout/cancellation chain and not retained separately.
cardinality_audit.underlabel_check: All 13 Level-2 rows and all 32 Level-3 candidates were considered; only the probe-only parallel phase cleared the retention gate.
cardinality_audit.overlabel_check: Only one label was retained because the other plausible labels restated downstream symptoms of the same investigation-then-timeout episode or lacked an independent consequence.
